name: Raissa
medium: Simultaneous Dual-Layer Architectural Cutaway & Continuous 10-Link Causal Joy Filament Shutter
anti_trude_vector: Slate-and-zinc multi-chamber cutaway of grim Raissa overlaid at every continuous second with a darting 10-node golden catenary joy filament, millisecond freeze-shutter proof, causal link stepper, and francolin parchment illumination.
inner_arch: Also in Raissa, city of sadness, an invisible thread binds one living being to another for a moment, unravels, and immediately stretches again between moving points so that at every second the unhappy city contains a happy city unaware of its own existence.

overt_unhappy_raissa: Streets where people walk wringing their hands
Figures leaning on river railings pressing fists to their temples
Morning waking from one bad dream as another begins
Workbenches where every moment hammers strike fingers or needles prick thumbs
Awry columns of figures in the ledgers of merchants and bankers
Rows of empty glasses on the messy zinc counters of wineshops with bent grim heads
Summer windows resounding with domestic quarrels and broken dishes
invisible_joy_causal_chain: 02: Dog jumps onto a shed to bite into a piece of fallen polenta
03: Young stonemason drops polenta from scaffolding shouting 'Darling, let me dip into it!'
04: Young serving-maid holds up a steaming dish of ragout under the pergola
05: Umbrella-maker celebrates a successful transaction of a white lace parasol
06: Great lady displays the white lace parasol at the rampart races
07: Beloved officer smiles at her while leaping the last barricade jump
08: Happier horse flies over obstacles seeing a francolin flying in the sky
09: Happy francolin bird liberated from its cage by a painter
10: Illuminator paints the feather speckled with red and yellow on the philosopher's parchment page
canonical_stones.philosopher_inscription: Also in Raissa, city of sadness, there runs an invisible thread that binds one living being to another for a moment, then unravels, then is stretched again between moving points as it draws new and rapid patterns so that at every second the unhappy city contains a happy city unaware of its own existence.
